newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler August vehicle output rises 9.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler August vehicle output rises 9.3 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said it produced a worldwide total of 225,807 cars and trucks during August, a 9.3 percent increase over the 206,526 vehicles it built in the same month of last year.

Chrysler said the total includes production of 3,303 minivans and Jeep Grand Cherokees in Austria, versus six a year earlier due to a model changeover. The remainder of the vehicles are built in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
Chrysler said it prioduced 74,389 cars in August, up 16.6 percent from the 63,775 it built a year earlier.
Chrysler said it built a total of 151,418 trucks during August, up 6.1 percent from 142,751 a year earlier.

Year-to-date, Chrysler has produced a total of 1,895,176 cars and trucks worldwide, an increase of 19.7 percent from the 1,595,824 vehicles it built a year earlier. Chrysler's car production so far this year is up 8.5 percent to 596,375 units, while truck production is up 24.1 percent to 1,298,801.
Chrysler's 1995 truck production was held back by a slower-than-expected launch of the company's current minivan models.
